text:
Ava: quick brain dump from today's architecture huddle: we need clearer semantics for "compatibility matrix" between hosting modes. proposing a tiny matrix doc + enforcement levels so SREs and sales can communicate guarantees to customers.
Ravi: +1. customers ask: "which signals will you see if we go private?" we should standardize what we advertise: identity, model-metadata, route, region, billing (hosted only).
Diego: thought: for private and dedicated, we need a discovery API that runtime can call to know 'available_signals'. controlplane responds with list and TTL. runtime can fall back to conservative defaults when signals are absent.
Nora: another runtime concern: token renewal during model streaming. if we force re-attestation mid-stream, user experience suffers. maybe allow streaming sessions to keep a hot lease with continuous keepalive.
Ava: keepalive is fine but keep short TTLs. propose streaming hot-lease TTL=30s with heartbeat; for bursty short requests stick with 5m token TTL.
Ravi: security: evidence must be minimal but verifiable. prefer SHA256(evidence_payload) in telemetry and JWS signature by broker. no raw attest data in logs.
Diego: integration note: dedicated customers often run via corporate proxy so attestation via mTLS + signed runtime nonce should be supported. make that an attestor type and document cert expectations.
Nora: fallback behavior rules: if a required signal is missing, decision flow: 1) if policy is 'must_have_signal' -> deny 2) else evaluate with unknown as false 3) record audit flag 'signal_missing'.
Ava: excellent. we should also add guidance for feature flags in dedicated to opt into telemetry sharing levels. some customers may allow identity and model metadata but not billing.
Ravi: UX: add a CLI check 'redwood check-compat --mode private' that simulates runtime and returns missing signals and suggested enforcement mapping. helpful for sales and onboarding.
Diego: latency budget doc: include expected added latency for attest types (hwm_attest 80-120ms, agent_signed 20-40ms, kms_release offline). guidance to prewarm for 99p latency-sensitive paths.
Nora: for the RFC: include sample JWS grant schema and minimal 'is_enforced' API example. also include a small JSON snippet of the compatibility matrix.
Ava: i started a draft matrix snippet:
```
signals_matrix:
  hosted: [tenant_id, model_id, route, geo, billing]
  dedicated: [tenant_id, model_id, route, geo]
  private: [tenant_id, model_id, route] # operator-configurable
```
Ravi: tasks: Ava finish matrix and doc, Diego add attestor certs section, Nora draft fallback rules and streaming guidance, I'll add CLI UX and onboarding checklist.
